OnlineUsers.description: Settings related to the online users feature.

Enable.description: Enable or disable the online users feature. This is used to indicate the number of online users in the backoffice and display their names.

Sounds.description: Settings related to the sounds played for user login and logout events.

Enable.description: Enable or disable the audio notifications for user login and logout events.

LoginSound.description: Path to the login sound file. This can be a relative path or an absolute URL.

LogoutSound.description: Path to the logout sound file. This can be a relative path or an absolute URL.

SignalRClientLogLevel.description: Used to set the log level of the SignalR Javascript client.

WebRTC.description: Settings for the WebRTC audio calling feature between backoffice users.

Enable.description: Enable or disable the WebRTC audio calling feature. When disabled, call buttons are hidden from the online users modal. This setting is reactively applied without restart.

StunServers.description: STUN server URLs used for ICE candidate gathering. Defaults to Google's free public STUN servers.

TurnServers.description: Optional TURN relay servers for environments where peer-to-peer connections cannot be established directly (e.g. symmetric NAT, strict firewalls). Leave empty to rely on STUN only.
